blogs.title: Reverse-Engineering Nothing Earbuds: Bluetooth RFCOMM & Dank Material Shell
blogs.description: [In the Works] Technical breakdown of sniffing Nothing & CMF audio protocol packets, building a lightweight Python daemon, and designing a native QML companion widget.
blogs.body:
## Reverse-Engineering Nothing Earbuds: Bluetooth RFCOMM & Dank Material Shell

> **Status:** Article in the works / draft in progress.

### Overview
This chronicle will document the end-to-end process of sniffing Nothing X protocol commands over RFCOMM, mapping battery state updates and active noise cancellation (ANC) toggles, and integrating them into Dank Material Shell using Python and Quickshell QML.

*Check back soon for the full technical breakdown and packet dumps.*

blogs.body:
## Hardware Prototyping: Fault Current Limiting Circuit Breaker (FCLCB)

> **Status:** Article in the works / draft in progress.

### Overview
Documenting the design and verification of a low-cost, solid-state fault current limiter. Covering zero-crossing detector circuitry, ACS712 current sensing, Arduino firing pulses, and experimental bench test results.

*Full engineering log coming soon.*
